messages:
Aisha: quick postmortem follow-up — saw another VPC peering flap impacting cust-lyra on dedicated yesterday (15:24 PT). symptoms: intermittent packet drops and session resets when their onprem router changed hold timers. putting actions here so we can assign and track.
Ben: can you paste the specific session logs/snippet?
Aisha: sure — relevant syslog excerpt:
```
Mar 22 15:23:49 bgpd[1234]: BGP: neighbor 10.8.0.2 down, holdtime expired
Mar 22 15:23:50 bgpd[1234]: BGP: neighbor 10.8.0.2 established
Mar 22 15:24:03 kernel: conntrack: NAT timeout spike seen
```
Ben: looks like a hold timer mismatch + our failover window. recurring pattern from earlier months.
Carlos: preliminary triage: their edge router lost sync during an onprem maintenance window. if we don't handle shorter hold timers we risk repeated isolation bugs.
Deb: I'll own a short-term mitigation: bump our keepalive grace to accept 3x misses for dedicated peers. I can land a config change and a test. ETA: end of day Thu.
Erin: I'll take automation of a synthetic BGP canary that flaps peering and verifies session restoration under shorter holds. adding to infra backlog, ETA next Wed.
Maya: I can prepare the customer-facing note for cust-lyra once we have the mitigation timeline. Draft by Fri for review with legal/CS.
Aisha: thanks. also want a medium-term runbook item: add a regression in our nightly that replays a 30s hold/restore pattern against Dedicated staging. Carlos, can you add that to the regression harness?
Carlos: yep — will add a harness job and mark it flaky-check if it fails >2 consecutive runs. ETA Monday.
incident-bot: Ticket RD-3421 created: "cust-lyra peering holdtime mitigation" assigned to Deb. Reminder set for 48h.
Ben: linking internal logs and graphs: https://redwood.internal/logs/peering/172500-lyra.log and perf dashboard https://redwood.internal/dashboards/peering/lyra
Aisha: summary of actions in-thread:
- Action 1: Temporary keepalive grace config (Deb) — EOD Thu — ticket RD-3421
- Action 2: Synthetic BGP canary + automation (Erin) — Wed next week
- Action 3: Nightly regression job added to harness (Carlos) — Mon
- Action 4: Customer comms draft (Maya) — Fri
- Action 5: Add incident to monthly recurring patterns review (Aisha) — next review meeting
Deb: starting RD-3421 now, will post PR and diff here when ready. :thumbsup:
Erin: added calendar invite for reconvene Tue 10am PT to review mitigations and rollout plan. @oncall please confirm availability. :calendar:
Carlos: ping me for router config snippets, I have the show run and BGP timers saved.
Maya: will coordinate comms and loop in CS. thanks all.
